messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The missing MMSC URL is indeed a common cause of MMS issues, and resetting the APN settings is a safe and standard procedure—it will restore the correct carrier settings for your phone. This won't delete your photos or personal data.

Please run: `reset_apn_settings` to reset your APN settings to the default configuration.

After you've done that, you must reboot your phone for the changes to take effect. Please run: `reboot_device` to restart your phone completely.

Once your phone has restarted, let me know, and we can test your MMS functionality again.

I have reset the APN settings to default and restarted my phone as you recommended. What should I do next? Should we try to send an MMS message again?

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
